name: TN J0924-2201 (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant radio galaxy TN J0924-2201, seen by Hubble.
label: tn09242201-hubble
story: Hubble searched this field for star-forming galaxies gathered around the distant radio galaxy TN J0924-2201. The radio galaxy has several confirmed companion galaxies and appears to lie in an unusually crowded region.

claims.text: TN J0924-2201 is a radio galaxy at z=5.2 observed with HST/ACS
The observations studied clustering of star-forming galaxies near the radio galaxy
The radio galaxy has spectroscopically confirmed companion galaxies and appears to lie in an overdense region
